newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks rise in lacklustre trade by lunch.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks rise in lacklustre trade by lunch.

text.p: Thai stocks gained slightly in bearish trade by the lunch break on Tuesday as investors, particularly foreigners, bought some large capitalised finance and bank stocks, brokers said.

"The market has slowly begun to pick up as most investors think that first quarter earnings results of finance firms being released now are in line with their expectations. They are accumulating stocks for speculative purposes," said a broker at a foreign brokerage.
The SET index rose 4.30 points to 698.51 on 1.07 billion baht turnover by the break.
Total net buying by foreigners on Monday amounted about 200 million baht.
Brokers said the market was also bearish because of an upcoming release of the country's key economic indicators by the central bank on Thursday.
"Investors are waiting for the monthly economic figures," one broker said.
Siam Makro topped the active list by lunch, falling one baht to 69. Krung Thai Bank was unchanged at 36.75 and General Finance gained 0.75 to 15.50.
